lines.zh: 囊袋一鼓一缩，我往前游。
lines.en: My sac swells and shrinks as I swim forward.

lines.zh: 我从沙底滑过去，鳍不出声。
lines.en: I slide over the sand; my fins make no sound.

lines.zh: 水流推着我走，我顺势偏了偏。
lines.en: The current pushes me and I lean into it.
Something inside me is heating up.
I circle the reef for half a turn.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，我蹿出去两丈。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I shoot two lengths out.

lines.zh: 光照下来，我的囊透着绿。
lines.en: Light comes down and my sac glows green.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底走，尽量不惊动沙。
lines.en: I skim the floor, keeping the sand quiet.

lines.zh: 还有猫在岸上，我记住了。
lines.en: There's a cat ashore; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢游，不急，反正跑不了。
lines.en: I swim slow — no hurry, it can't escape.
A faint hiss comes from my sac.
I slip along the edge of the weed bed.
I swing around the crab.

lines.zh: 体内的东西又涨了一点。
lines.en: The thing inside me swells a little more.
I pass a sunken hull without stopping.

lines.zh: 我控制着速度，别太早炸。
lines.en: I pace myself; don't blow too early.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，囊慢慢收缩。
lines.en: I hang in the water as my sac contracts.
There's pressure inside me with no way out.
I'm waiting for something close enough.

lines.zh: 绿光在我身上一层层亮。
lines.en: Green light pulses over me in layers.
Grass on the bank crunches underfoot.

lines.zh: 水流绕过我，我的囊在响。
lines.en: Water flows past and my sac crackles.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，看起来很无害。
lines.en: I hold very still and look harmless.
I'm measuring how far I can reach.
My scales are slowly puffing up.
There's a faint ring in the sand.
I'm waiting for that dull boom.
The gas in my sac swells me tight.
The nearby fish left long ago.

lines.zh: 囊上有一道旧裂口，没漏。
lines.en: An old split in my sac, but nothing leaks.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，我数着你的手指
lines.en: As you bend, I count your fingers.

lines.zh: 我浮上来一点，和你对着。
lines.en: I rise a little and face you.
My body puffs a little.
I know you want to get in the water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地靠近，不留痕迹。
lines.en: I drift in close without a ripple.
Watch the sac; it's still swelling.
One step back from you, one foot in from me.
I won't shout; that would spoil it.
The water is mine.
I'm in the shallows by your feet.

lines.zh: 囊壁瘪下去，气漏了一半
lines.en: My sac wall caved; half the gas escaped.
The green light flickers wildly; I back off.
The pressure inside me scatters.
I roll half over before righting myself.
The gunpowder smell grew stronger.
I sink to the bottom to hide.
A split opened along my fin.
Even wounded, I can still blow.
I scrape along the reef.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是慢慢鼓起来。
lines.en: I make no sound; I just swell.

lines.zh: 有肉味进了水，我很感兴趣。
lines.en: Meat smell in the water — I'm interested.

lines.zh: 你把它扔下来，我看看真假。
lines.en: Drop it in; I'll see if it's real.
I swim after the scent, steady.

lines.zh: 我吃之前，先确认没有钩子。
lines.en: Before I eat, I check for a hook.

lines.zh: 这味道让我体内的东西更响了。
lines.en: The smell makes my insides hiss louder.
I'm not rushing; slow does it.
That smell isn't fish. It's metal.
I swallow it whole, bones and all.
Done, and I'm still hungry.
Is there more nearby?
You bump me and my sac lurches.
Underwater collisions are muffled.

lines.zh: 我贴着你滑过去，皮肤很凉。
lines.en: I slide against you; my skin is cold.
Don't shove; the sac will swell early.
The push rolls me half over.

lines.zh: 我们缠在了一根水草上。
lines.en: We're tangled in the same weed.
I back off to get clear of you.
There's a gunpowder smell about me.

lines.zh: 你的靴子碰到了我的背。
lines.en: Your boot grazed my back.
I don't like this sort of thing.
My body glows, slowly.

lines.zh: 两条囊鱼靠近，水开始发烫。
lines.en: Two sac-fish near each other and the water warms.
We circle one another.

lines.zh: 我的囊里有了新的东西。
lines.en: Something new is forming in my sac.
This patch of water is very quiet.
We sink together to the sand.

lines.zh: 水草盖住了我们的影子。
lines.en: The weeds cover our shadows.
I touch its fin.
There are no cats around here.
We part, slowly.
I take a piece of fish and don't chew.
Something glints on the bottom.
I take it into my sac.
This stone has algae on it.

lines.zh: 我碰了一下，它就滚开了。
lines.en: I nudge it and it rolls away.
Too small to bother opening my mouth.
I hold it and slowly swell.
There's something inside this shell.
I spit it out — a scrap of iron.
I pick up another one.
You stepped into the water.

lines.zh: 我体内的东西一下胀满。
lines.en: The thing inside me swells full at once.
Locked on; I go green all over.
The water barely stirs.
Twenty-four blocks is enough.

lines.zh: 退到礁石边，你就没处躲
lines.en: Backed against the reef, you've nowhere left.

lines.zh: 我的囊在响，你听得见吗？
lines.en: My sac is hissing — can you hear it?
I want to get close enough to hold you.
One of your feet is still on land.
I speed up and come straight at you.
I swim alongside you without hurrying.
You get out; I wait in the water.
My body is getting hotter.

lines.zh: 你把手里的东西握紧了
lines.en: You tighten your grip on that thing.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我沉下去。
lines.en: When you look back, I sink.
I'm faster than you in the water.
I cut around in front of you.
The green glow shows clearly underwater.
I'm counting how many steps away you are.
Just a little closer.
I ram it headfirst — a light touch.
My body presses against it.
Sparks light up along my back.
My teeth sink in and stay.
The pressure in my sac lets go.
A boom, and the water turns over.
I blew, and I'm still here.
It's been thrown up onto the bank.
I withdraw behind the reef.

lines.zh: 咬住之后，我身上的光变亮
lines.en: Once I bite, the glow on me brightens.

lines.zh: 我从深水里浮上来，囊还在鼓。
lines.en: I rise from the deep with my sac still swelling.

lines.zh: 第一眼就看见岸上有影子。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a shape on the bank.
The water is colder than I expected.
I stretch my body out.
Green light sways over the sand.
Gunpowder taste is still in my mouth.
The nearby fish scatter at once.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉到礁石阴影里。
lines.en: I settle into the reef's shadow.
My sac starts its count.
The water's shallow here; nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 火在水下也咬到了我的鳞。
lines.en: Even underwater the fire bites my scales.
Stone digs into my soft belly.

lines.zh: 水把我灌满了，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water fills me and I can't rise.
The blast came early, and I was inside it.
A harpoon pierces my sac.
Something is thrashing inside me.

lines.zh: 囊空了，连气都胀不起来。
lines.en: My sac is empty; I can't even puff up.

lines.zh: 水一通电，我的鳍全僵了
lines.en: The current hits the water and my fins lock.
The water has no bottom; I keep sinking.
